entities.name: CTP synthase candidate
observations: 552-aa query; 78.4% identity and 98.7% query coverage to reviewed Nitratidesulfovibrio vulgaris CTP synthase Q72BL2.
Predicted domains: CTP_synth_N (residues 4–267) and GATase (residues 303–536), supporting a two-domain CTP synthase architecture.
Strong-homology annotation supports ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP using glutamine or ammonia; homolog is reported homotetrameric and subject to GTP activation and CTP feedback inhibition.
